curriculum.title: Getting Started

steps.title: Customer discovery
steps.instruction: Describe the customer, their problem and what you learned from talking to them.

steps.title: Offer and professional profile
steps.instruction: Draft an offer, a professional headline, an About paragraph, and three skills or project examples. Eligible students can update their own LinkedIn profile or prepare a private or paper portfolio with the school administrator.

curriculum.examPrompt: Explain who your first customer is, how you verified their problem, and how your offer helps them.

curriculum.title: Intermediate / Advanced

steps.title: Run a pilot
steps.instruction: Describe your prototype or service and record what a prospective customer did or said when testing it.

steps.title: Set a price
steps.instruction: Show your delivery costs, selling price, and anticipated margin.

curriculum.examPrompt: Explain what your pilot taught you and how your costs informed your price.

curriculum.title: Funding (Aid)

steps.title: Forecast cash flow
steps.instruction: Estimate your next three months of cash coming in and payments going out.

steps.title: Choose a funding plan
steps.instruction: Explain the amount you need, how you would use it, and whether you would fund it from sales or an external source.

curriculum.examPrompt: Describe your funding choice, projected cash needs, and the milestone this money will help you reach.
